judgments.support_quote: the club concluded the Section 106 agreement with Haringey Council
judgments.rationale: 本地Tottenham留队与Haringey审批提供行政区域线索，不能仅凭审批机关把新球场具体地址认定为完整答案。

judgments.support_quote: remaining plots on the Paxton Road required for the development to proceed
judgments.rationale: 交代项目需要取得Paxton Road地块，支持建设区域，但未在本段明确这些地块与新球场主体的完整位置关系。

judgments.support_quote: The Northumberland Park, Tottenham Hale and White Hart Lane station
judgments.rationale: 明确新球场相关的交通站点，提供附近地理线索；不能把多个交通站点直接当作球场精确所在地。

judgments.support_quote: the new stadium would be built alongside the existing White Hart Lane
judgments.rationale: 明确初始方案的地点，但本段谈早期拟建方案而非最终施工方案；保留为部分支持，避免把历史计划当成当前布局。

judgments.support_quote: Tottenham announced that it would stay in North Tottenham
judgments.rationale: 球队留在North Tottenham并计划搬入新球场，提供地区线索；留队公告与当年原定搬入时间不等于最终球场具体位置。

judgments.support_quote: The project covers the site of the now demolished ground of White Hart Lane and areas adjacent to it.

judgments.support_quote: purchase of a factory on Paxton Road

judgments.support_quote: the area between the stadium and White Hart Lane station
judgments.rationale: 给出体育场与White Hart Lane站附近再生区的空间关系，提供地区支持；描述更新区而非直接定义新球场主体位置。

judgments.support_quote: after White Hart Lane had been demolished
judgments.rationale: 施工新南看台与拆除White Hart Lane相联，可支持旧场地附近的建设关系；本段未完整交代新球场的位置范围。

judgments.support_quote: The High Road pavement would be widened
judgments.rationale: 项目设计关联High Road和附近建筑，提供周边位置线索；没有直接定义新球场所在地。

judgments.support_quote: bordered by Park Lane to the South, Worcester Avenue to the East, Northumberland Park to the North and the High Road to the West.
judgments.rationale: 明确整个发展项目的四至，支持所在区域；区分项目范围和球场主体范围，不把同段暂用Wembley当作建设地点。

judgments.support_quote: A revised plan was first approved in 2010 by the Haringey Council

judgments.support_quote: the building of a new stadium in Tottenham

judgments.support_quote: a wider regeneration scheme in Tottenham
judgments.rationale: 明确项目关联Tottenham的更新区域，并谈旧场White Hart Lane；未直接陈述新球场建设地址，保留为位置背景支持。

judgments.support_quote: the building of the new Tottenham Hotspur Stadium to replace White Hart Lane
